mood: A drone back on its charger, a nap in class, and a plan for coming home, said on a roof just in case.

hero.alt: In a bright Academy stairwell a blonde student in uniform swings down the hall with her arms flung wide and a silver dragon machine at her side, streamers of light swirling around her, while pink-haired Guinevere and black-haired Vexana follow a few steps behind on the stairs.

media.alt: In a bright classroom Selena sleeps on her arms at her desk, dreaming of a cupcake with a cherry on top, while a classmate behind her holds up a paper plane.

inserts.caption: A nap, a paper plane, and a cupcake that was hers.
